title: Credit Administration Policy: How Many Personal Credit Cards One Customer May Hold
content:
1. A customer of Piedmont Crescent Bank may hold more than one card under Personal Credit Cards, but never two of the same tier.

2. The count of the customer's card accounts standing in applied, active or suspended status must be below 3 before a new application is recorded. The count is taken from the bank's own card records, before the application is recorded, over every card account carried under that customer's profile; the customer's own account of how many cards they hold does not settle it.

3. The customer may not hold another card of the requested tier in applied, active or suspended status. Sameness of tier is judged on the customer and the tier together, from the bank's card records before the application is recorded: a second application for a tier the customer already carries in one of those three statuses is a holding of the same tier.

4. A customer with any card account in charged-off status cannot open a new card, whatever the tier applied for.

5. Closed accounts do not count, neither towards the count of cards held nor towards the bar on holding the same tier twice.

**Condition table.** The three tests of this policy stand together; an application is recorded only where each reads as shown.

| What the card records show for the customer | Count below 3 | No other card of the requested tier in applied, active or suspended status | No card account in charged-off status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 active cards of other tiers, none charged off | satisfied | satisfied | satisfied |
| 3 cards in applied, active or suspended status | not satisfied | judged separately | judged separately |
| 1 active card of the requested tier | satisfied | not satisfied | satisfied |
| 1 active card, 1 charged-off card | satisfied | judged separately | not satisfied |
| 4 closed cards, 1 active card of another tier | satisfied | satisfied | satisfied |

**On the boundary of the count.** The count must be below 3, so a customer already carrying 3 cards in applied, active or suspended status is outside the policy, while a customer carrying 2 such cards is inside it. A customer holding 5 cards of which 4 are closed carries a count of 1.
